svg.title: EAIFR selected international connections
svg.desc: Muted dots form the land. Teal markers identify San Diego, Salamanca, Paris, Lausanne, Rome, Cambridge and Abu Dhabi. Gold marks EAIFR in Kigali. Locations are supported by the official EAIFR partnerships and people pages.

g.title: San Diego: Dave May, Scripps Institution of Oceanography
Salamanca: Mario Amado Montero, University of Salamanca
Lausanne: Sara Bonella, EPFL; CECAM and NCCR-MARVEL in Switzerland
Abu Dhabi: Arjun Narayanan, NYU Abu Dhabi
